formal_statement: ∃ w d : ℕ, ∀ p : Polynomial ℕ, ∃ (n : ℕ) (F : Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))), (∀ C ∈ F, C.card ≤ w) ∧ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCRefutable (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.cnfSystem (↑F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n)))) d ∧ ∀ π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause (Fin n)), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation (↑F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))) π → p.eval n < π.length
plain_statement: There are constants w, d such that for every polynomial p some CNF on n variables of width at most w has an F2 polynomial calculus refutation of degree d while every dag-like Res(+) refutation has more than p(n) lines. Conjecture; open in our reading (open item 2 of doctrine/KNOWN/proof_complexity.md; for lifted Tseitin only a quadratic bound is in print). Intended family: the lifted system of L-pcx-065. Dead routes: ProofComplexity/LiftSize/ and notes/pcx-lifted-tseitin.md.
